pages.title: Personalised Rag Doll - Mischievous Maeve
pages.description: Personalised Rag dolls at WowWee have personalities and characters for all children. Some children collect all of our dolls. They are well made and great to play with.
pages.ld_description:
[Gift Details]

A sweet new companion for any child. Mischievous Maeve comes with her own dress, socks and shoes. Other outfits are also available to purchase and personalise
As seen on the Late Late Toy Show 
Mischievous Maeve is 50cm tall
Child's name beautifully embroidered on the doll's skirt (in a complementary thread) makes this an extra special gift
CE Standard Tested

Enjoy Free Delivery on all orders over €70 throughout Ireland
